title: Aggressive Negotiations
text: Attack with a unit. For this attack, it gets +1/+0 for each card in your hand.
rules:
If you play Aggressive Negotiations, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
The attacking unit gets +1/+0 for each card in your hand at the start of the attack (not counting Aggressive Negotiations). This power increase doesn't change if you draw or discard cards as part of the attack.
